entries.text: Stoneford has no warm welcome for newly arrived adventurers, but it remembers those who settle their bills and keep their word.

In Jadestone there is a young adventurer called Rowan, a man of more talent than luck, who is chasing the legend of the Edge of the World in the far north: they say there is a cave there with no bottom, which keeps spitting out relics and wondrous devices that no one can account for.
The crypt at Mossbarrow lies outside town; rumour has it there is a coffin there that talks.
